description: This file defines a struct named SingleSegmentBuffer that implements the IBufferWriter<byte> interface. It manages a byte array buffer, providing methods for writing data, retrieving memory and span references, converting to array or string, and resetting the buffer.

methods.name: SingleSegmentBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer with the provided byte array and sets the written count to zero.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the written position by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> representing the unfilled portion of the buffer.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> representing the unfilled portion of the buffer.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts the written portion of the buffer to a byte array.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer's written count to zero.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Property that returns the number of bytes written to the buffer.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySpan
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySpan<byte> of the written data.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Decodes the written bytes into a UTF8 string.
